# pyenv
#   For a library or package, you might want to ignore these files since the code is
#   intended to run in multiple environments; otherwise, check them in:
# .python-version

# pipenv
#   According to pypa/pipenv#598, it is recommended to include Pipfile.lock in version control.
#   However, in case of collaboration, if having platform-specific dependencies or dependencies
#   having no cross-platform support, pipenv may install dependencies that don't work, or not
#   install all needed dependencies.
#Pipfile.lock

# poetry
#   Similar to Pipfile.lock, it is generally recommended to include poetry.lock in version control.
#   This is especially recommended for binary packages to ensure reproducibility, and is more
#   commonly ignored for libraries.
#   https://python-poetry.org/docs/basic-usage/#commit-your-poetrylock-file-to-version-control
#poetry.lock

# pdm
#   Similar to Pipfile.lock, it is generally recommended to include pdm.lock in version control.
#pdm.lock
#   pdm stores project-wide configurations in .pdm.toml, but it is recommended to not include it
#   in version control.
#   https://pdm.fming.dev/latest/usage/project/#working-with-version-control
.pdm.toml
.pdm-python
.pdm-build/

# PEP 582; used by e.g. github.com/David-OConnor/pyflow and github.com/pdm-project/pdm

### AI-DLC
# BEGIN AI-DLC:gitignore
# Logs
logs
*.log
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*
pnpm-debug.log*
lerna-debug.log*

node_modules
dist
dist-ssr
*.local

# Editor directories and files
.vscode/*
!.vscode/extensions.json
.idea
.DS_Store
*.suo
*.ntvs*
*.njsproj
*.sln
*.sw?

# AI-DLC — the committed-vs-ignored split (workspace layout, re-rooted under aidlc/).
# Rule of thumb (vision §5.1): per-user session CURSORS and machine-local
# runtime/derived state are ignored; everything that is the shared work —
# method, registry, state, AUDIT (per-clone shards), artifacts — is committed.
#
# Per-user session cursors — ignored (two teammates legitimately point at
# different spaces/intents at once; committing them would turn per-user
# navigation into shared state and cause conflicts on intent creation and cursor switches).
aidlc/active-space
aidlc/spaces/*/intents/active-intent
#
# Machine-local runtime / derived — ignored (regenerated per machine).
# The clone-id token names this clone's audit shard; it MUST stay machine-local
# (gitignored) or every clone from a commit would share a shard and git-conflict.
aidlc/.aidlc-clone-id
aidlc/.aidlc-unit-scope.json
aidlc/.aidlc-unit-parked
aidlc/.aidlc-claim-generations.json
aidlc/.aidlc-unit-participant
aidlc/.aidlc-claim-registry.json
aidlc/.aidlc-unit-releases/
aidlc/.aidlc-unit-merges/
# Atomic active-space create staging (normally unlinked immediately).
aidlc/.aidlc-active-space-*.tmp
# Per-conversation session→intent map (resume rebind, P8): per-user runtime
# state keyed by Claude Code session_id, never shared truth.
aidlc/.aidlc-sessions/
aidlc/spaces/*/intents/.aidlc-*
# Framework state at any depth, including the bare space intents root and
# package-local record trees; keep unrelated application dot folders visible.
**/aidlc/spaces/*/intents/**/.aidlc-engine/
**/aidlc/spaces/*/intents/**/.aidlc-sensors/
# DocumentKB staged-transaction scratch: `onboard` stages a document into
# `.journal/<txn-id>/` and renames it into place under the audit lock. Per-clone
# and transient -- a committed journal would be a merge conflict on every
# concurrent sync, and a crashed run's leftovers would be committed as if they
# were work. Collected on the next sync; named by txn id, referenced by no index
# row, so removal is always safe.
aidlc/spaces/*/knowledge/documentkb/.journal/
# DocumentKB `linked`-source alias map: alias -> a machine-specific ABSOLUTE
# root. Committing it would give every clone one developer's directory layout,
# which is the exact failure the "never an absolute path in committed metadata"
# rule exists to prevent. The committed side holds only the alias.
aidlc/spaces/*/knowledge/.sources.local.json
aidlc/spaces/*/intents/*/runtime-graph.json
aidlc/spaces/*/intents/*/.aidlc-*
# Redacted diagnostic reports (/aidlc --doctor --export): regenerated, meant to
# be shared then deleted — machine-local derived output, never shared truth.
aidlc/diagnostics/
#
# COMMITTED (NOT ignored, listed here for the record — do NOT add ignore rules
# for these): aidlc/spaces/*/memory/** · aidlc/spaces/*/codekb/** ·
# aidlc/spaces/*/intents/intents.json · aidlc/spaces/*/intents/*/aidlc-state.md ·
# aidlc/spaces/*/intents/*/audit/*.md (the audit trail, committed as PER-CLONE
# SHARDS: each machine appends to audit/<host>-<clone>.md so git never merges
# concurrent appends — there is intentionally NO .gitattributes merge=union,
# which was proven to corrupt the multi-line audit blocks) ·
# aidlc/spaces/*/intents/*/<phase>/<stage>/*.md (artifacts + diary).
.claude/settings.local.json
# END AI-DLC:gitignore
